```{r, functions to plot oysters, eval=TRUE, echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(glue)
library(kableExtra)
library(sf)
library(ggplot2)
# Read in oyster results file
oyster_stats <- fread("output/OIMMP/Oyster_All_GLMM_Stats.txt", sep='|')
# Function to add trend text
trendText <- function(modelEstimate, lowConfidence, upConfidence, sufficientData){
  if(sufficientData){
    increasing <- modelEstimate > 0
    trendPresent <- (lowConfidence < 0 & upConfidence < 0) | 
      (lowConfidence > 0 & upConfidence > 0)
    trendStatus <- "No significant change"
    if(isTRUE(trendPresent)){
      trendDirection <- ifelse(increasing, "increasing", "decreasing")
      trendStatus <- paste0("Significantly ", trendDirection, " trend")
    } else if(is.na(modelEstimate)){
      trendStatus <- "A model could not be fitted"
    }
  } else {
    trendStatus <- "Insufficient data"
  }
  return(trendStatus)
}
# Apply function, add credible interval
oyster_stats <- oyster_stats %>% rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    "Trend Status" = trendText(ModelEstimate, LowerConfidence, UpperConfidence, SufficientData),
    "Credible Interval" = ifelse(!is.na(LowerConfidence), paste0(round(LowerConfidence, 2), " to ", round(UpperConfidence, 2)), NA)
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>% as.data.table()

# Oyster plot locations
oy_figs <- list(
  "Density" = list.files("output/OIMMP/Figures/Density/", pattern = ".png", full.names = T),
  "Percent Live" = list.files("output/OIMMP/Figures/Percent_Live/", pattern = ".png", full.names = T),
  "Shell Height" = list.files("output/OIMMP/Figures/Shell_Height/", pattern = ".png", full.names = T)
)

# Dataframe to determine which figures are included
oyster_includes <- oyster_stats %>% 
  group_by(OIMMP, ParameterName, SufficientData, HabitatType, Intercept) %>%
  reframe() %>% as.data.table()

oyster_includes <- oyster_includes[!(HabitatType=="Restored" & OIMMP=="Apalachicola Bay" & ParameterName=="Shell Height")]

# Function to locate oyster figures
oy_file_loc <- function(ma_abrev, p, type){
  if(p=="Density"){
    pattern <- paste0("_GLMM_", ma_abrev, "_", type, "_raw.png")
  } else if(p=="Percent Live"){
    pattern <- paste0("_GLMM_", ma_abrev, "_", type, "_raw.png")
  } else if(p=="Shell Height"){
    pattern <- paste0("_GLMM_", ma_abrev, "_", type, ".png")
  }
  return(str_subset(oy_figs[[p]], pattern))
}

# Function to display oyster results tables
oyster_tables <- function(ma, p, type){
  if(p=="Shell Height"){
    select_cols <- c("ShellType", "SizeClass", "HabitatType", "Trend Status", "ModelEstimate", "StandardError", "Credible Interval")
  } else {
    select_cols <- c("ShellType", "HabitatType", "Trend Status", "ModelEstimate", "StandardError", "Credible Interval")
  }
  subset <- oyster_stats[OIMMP==ma & ParameterName==p & HabitatType==type,]
  ResultTable <- subset %>% 
    dplyr::select(select_cols) %>%
    dplyr::rename("Shell Type" = "ShellType",
                  "Habitat Type" = "HabitatType",
                  "Estimate" = "ModelEstimate",
                  "Standard Error" = "StandardError")
  if(p=="Shell Height"){
    ResultTable <- ResultTable %>% 
      filter(!is.na(SizeClass)) %>%
      dplyr::rename("Size Class" = "SizeClass")
  }
  
  result_table <- kable(ResultTable, format = tableFormat,
                        caption = paste0("Model results for Oyster ", p, " - ", type),
                        row.names = FALSE, digits = 2,
                        booktabs = T, linesep = "", escape = F, longtable = F) %>%
    row_spec(row = 0, italic = TRUE) %>%
    kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "HOLD_position"))
  
  print(result_table)
}

# Function to allow dynamic plot sizes
subchunkify <- function(g, fig_height=9, fig_width=10, fig_cap) {
  g_deparsed <- paste0(deparse(
    function() {g}
  ), collapse = '')

  sub_chunk <- paste0("
  \n`","``{r sub_chunk_", floor(runif(1) * 10000), ", fig.height=",
   fig_height, ", fig.width=", fig_width, ", echo=FALSE, results='asis'}",
  "\n(", 
    g_deparsed
    , ")()",
  "\n`","``
  ")

  cat(knitr::knit(text = knitr::knit_expand(text = sub_chunk), quiet = TRUE))
}

map_locs <- list.files("output/maps/OIMMP", full.names = T, pattern = ".png")
get_maps <- function(indicator_short, ma_abrev){
  str_subset(map_locs, paste0(indicator_short, "_", ma_abrev))
}

# Read in table description file
tableDesc <- fread("output/oyster_tableDescriptions_OIMMP.csv")

##### Table + plots to display OIMMP reef stats (OysterReefID output)
show_reef_overview <- function(oimmp){
  # Determine color palette for all programs
  oimmp_programs <- unique(reef_data_overview$ProgramID)
  prog_palette <- colorRampPalette(seacar_palette)(length(oimmp_programs))
  names(prog_palette) <- oimmp_programs
  # Locate relevant files
  txt_string <- paste0(gsub(" ", "_", oimmp), "_reef_overview")
  reef_overview_file <- list.files("output/OIMMP/ReportFigures/", full=T, pattern = txt_string)
  # Subset reefs for each OIMMP region
  reef_subset <- reef_data_overview %>% filter(OIMMP==oimmp)
  if(nrow(reef_subset)==0) next
  # Gather total number of reefs in region
  n_reefs_tot <- reef_overview %>% filter(OIMMP==oimmp) %>% pull(n)
  # Gather total number of reefs sampled in region
  n_reefs_sampled <- unique(reef_subset$n_tot)
  cat("  \n")
  cat(glue("Total number of FWC reefs in {oimmp} OIMMP region: {n_reefs_tot}. 
           Number of unique reefs that have been sampled: {n_reefs_sampled} 
           ({round((n_reefs_sampled / n_reefs_tot)*100,1)}%)."))
  cat("  \n")
  # Create reef plot to show overview
  fig_cap <- glue("Number of oyster reefs sampled by SEACAR ProgramID in {oimmp}")
  # PLOT HERE
  subchunkify(cat("![", fig_cap, "](", reef_overview_file,")"))
  
  # Create table overview
  ResultTable <- reef_subset %>%
    dplyr::select(ProgramID, n_reefs, n_tot) %>% 
    dplyr::rename("Number of URIDs sampled by ProgramID" = "n_reefs",
                  "Number of URIDs sampled in OIMMP Region" = "n_tot")
  # Convert to kable
  result_table <- kable(ResultTable, format = tableFormat,
                        caption = paste0("Number of UniversalReefIDs (URID) sampled in ", oimmp, "; ", n_reefs_sampled, " mapped reefs"),
                        row.names = FALSE, digits = 2,
                        booktabs = T, linesep = "", escape = F, longtable = F) %>%
    kableExtra::row_spec(row = 0, italic = TRUE) %>%
    kableExtra::kable_styling(latex_options = c("scale_down", "HOLD_position"))
  cat("  \n")
  # cat("  \n")
  # print(result_table)
  cat("  \n")
  for(p_id in unique(reef_subset$ProgramID)){
    p_name <- reef_subset[reef_subset$ProgramID==p_id, ]$ProgramName
    me <- managing_entities[ProgramID==p_id, ManagingEntity]
    cat(paste0("**", p_id, "** - ", p_name, " - *", me, "*   \n"))
  }
  cat("  \n")
}

# Function to show SD plots and maps for each parameter
show_sd_plots <- function(oimmp, p){
  # text string to isolate relevant oimmp - param combination (both map and plot)
  txt_string <- paste0(gsub(" ", "_", oimmp), "_", gsub(" ", "_", p))
  sd_files <- list.files("output/OIMMP/ReportFigures/",full=T, pattern = txt_string)
  cat("  \n")
  subchunkify(cat("![", glue("Map of standard deviation by reef for oyster {tolower(p)} in {oimmp}"), "](", str_subset(sd_files, "_sdmap"),")"))
  cat("  \n")
  subchunkify(cat("![", glue("Standard deviation by sample size and number of sites for oyster {tolower(p)} in {oimmp}"), "](", str_subset(sd_files, "_sdplot"),")"))
  cat("  \n")
}
# Function to display maps for each parameter
show_maps <- function(oimmp, p, indicator_short){
  ma_short <- gsub(" ", "_", oimmp)
  map_loc <- get_maps(indicator_short = indicator_short, ma_abrev = ma_short)
  map_caption <- glue("Map showing sampling locations by program for oyster {tolower(p)} in {oimmp}")
  subchunkify(cat("![",map_caption,"](", map_loc,")"))
}

# Import and include Managing Entity information
managing_entities <- openxlsx::read.xlsx("data/MonitoringPrograms_ManagingEntityUpdate_2025-12.xlsx") %>% as.data.table()
managing_entities[, `:=` (ManagingEntity = ifelse(is.na(Managing.Entity_proposed), Managing.Entity, Managing.Entity_proposed))] %>%
  setnames(., "Id", "ProgramID")
```

```{r, Oyster_figures, eval=T, echo=F, results='asis', warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
## Begin report display
for(oimmp in unique(oyster_includes$OIMMP)){
  cat("  \n")
  cat("\\newpage")
  cat("  \n")
  # Grab table description
  ma_subset <- oyster_includes[OIMMP==oimmp, ]
  cat("  \n")
  cat(glue("# {oimmp}"))
  cat("  \n")
  cat("In the following sections, the values for 'Number of reefs sampled' 
      may add up to more than 100% because the same reef may have been sampled by more than one program.")
  cat("  \n")
  subchunkify(show_reef_overview(oimmp), fig_height = 6, fig_width = 10)
  cat("  \n")
  for(p in unique(ma_subset$ParameterName)){
    # Indicator short
    indicator_short <- ifelse(p=="Density", "Dens", ifelse(p=="Percent Live", "PrcLive", "SH"))
    cat("  \n")
    cat(glue("## {p}"))
    cat("  \n")
    subchunkify(show_maps(oimmp = oimmp, p = p, indicator_short = indicator_short), fig_height = 6, fig_width = 10)
    cat("  \n")
    subchunkify(show_sd_plots(oimmp, p), fig_height = 6, fig_width = 10)
    cat("  \n")
    # parameter subset
    p_subset <- ma_subset[ParameterName==p, ]
    # Add table description before Natural vs. Restored (text describes both trends)
    cat("  \n")
    desc <- tableDesc[OIMMP==oimmp & HabitatName=="Oyster/Oyster Reef" & ParameterName==p, get(descriptionColumn)] 
    cat("  \n")
    cat(desc)
    # Determine which habitats are available for each parameter / OIMMP combination
    hab_types <- unique(p_subset$HabitatType)
    for(type in hab_types){
      type_subset <- p_subset[HabitatType==type, ]
      if(nrow(type_subset)>0){
        cat("  \n")
        cat(glue("### {type}"))
        cat("  \n")
        plot_loc <- oy_file_loc(oimmp, p, type)
        fig_caption <- figureCaptions[HabitatName=="Oyster/Oyster Reef" & IndicatorName==p, FigureCaptions]
        subchunkify(cat("![", fig_caption, "](", plot_loc,")"))
        cat("  \n")
        oyster_tables(oimmp, p, type)
        cat("  \n")
      }
    }
    cat("  \n")
  }
}
```
